method: frame-accurate teardown of 2 reels; region-aware cut detection (full-frame diff AND talking-head-card diff), optical caption timing, phase-correlation camera test, multi-scale 2D registration, spectral audio tests

caveats: Both files are Instagram delivery re-encodes at 720x1280, NOT masters. Master is near-certainly 1080x1920.
Source fps is 24 / 23.976 - NOT 30. Any frames@30 value is a conversion (seconds*30), not a measurement.
Source URLs not captured; creator identity unknown and deliberately not guessed. '@Kallawaymarketing' appears INSIDE video A's hook graphic as the demonstrated account - not evidence of authorship.

CONSTANTS._note: held across BOTH videos - safe to encode

structure.alternation: strict ABAB, zero exceptions in 33 shots

camera._note: the ONLY scale change is the hard-cut mode switch

geometry_pct._basis: fractions of frame width/height - authoritative, resolution independent

grade.character: crushed blacks, low-key, high contrast footage against flat desaturated graphics

captions.colour_rule: white on dark, #0F0D0F on light board

typography.headline_rule: bold grotesque + ONE italic-serif word + ONE red-accent phrase
typography.caption_weight: heavy/black grotesque, tight tracking, soft dark shadow over footage

VARIABLES._note: DIFFERED between the two videos - per-video decisions, do NOT average

MOTION_DURATIONS._units: frames at source fps (24) unless noted
MOTION_DURATIONS.easing: ease-out into settle; NO spring, NO overshoot, NO bounce anywhere

PRIMITIVES.name: TalkingHeadCard
PRIMITIVES.role: bottom-anchored rounded card bleeding off-frame + optional background-removed pop-out layer breaking the top edge

PRIMITIVES.name: WordCaption
PRIMITIVES.role: one word, centred, hard swap, zero animation, colour inverts with board

PRIMITIVES.name: Headline
PRIMITIVES.role: grotesque + italic-serif word + red phrase; type-on or fade

PRIMITIVES.name: RevealList
PRIMITIVES.role: numbered rows, 3 states: revealed / active (red chip + highlight box) / unrevealed (gaussian blur)

PRIMITIVES.name: DrawOn
PRIMITIVES.role: stroke-dashoffset path reveal + optional group scale-up

PRIMITIVES.name: PhoneMock
PRIMITIVES.role: secondary - static device frame, hard-cutting inner clip

UNRESOLVED: SFX layer: HF transients land within 120ms of a cut on 4/16 (A) and 7/15 (B) vs ~20% chance. B's excess is suggestive but confounded - cuts land on word onsets, which contain plosives/sibilants. Not separable at 63kb/s HE-AAC.
Caption detection recovers 92% (A) / 77% (B) of spoken words. Whether the residual is detector miss or genuine word-grouping is not separable at this resolution.
Whether -14 LUFS is the creator's master or Instagram's normalisation.
Master resolution, source URLs, creator identity - unknown, not back-filled.
FAILED_TESTS: Naive top-anchored centre-aligned scale matching between card and full-bleed returned ncc~0.00 and a meaningless 2.4x. Full 2D registration (scale x translation) required.
Raw Whisper word timings drift to 90s on a 62.5s file - unusable. All caption timing measured optically from the picture.
Luma-only frame-diff cut detection fires on graphics, not edits. Must gate on the talking-head-card region changing too.
Silence detection at -32dB found ZERO silence in either file - a music-bed test based on gap loudness alone would have been a false positive.
